brand.name: Lachen & Co.
brand.tagline_tr: Restoran Teknolojilerinde Yeni Nesil NFC & AI Ekosistemi
brand.tagline_en: Next-Gen NFC & AI Ecosystem for Modern Dining

logo.description: White wordmark 'LACHEN.CO.' followed by three concentric animated NFC radio-wave arcs attached to the trailing dot.

design_philosophy.vibe: Ultra-minimal, dark tech luxury, high contrast, cinematic, precision engineering
design_philosophy.inspiration: octopuseffect.com dark aesthetic with custom kinetic typography, crisp 1px borders, subtle glassmorphism and subtle glowing NFC wave indicators
design_philosophy.no_fake_data_rule: Strictly NO fake testimonials, NO fake company metrics, NO fake client counts or artificial press logos anywhere on the site.

motion_system.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration for weighted scrolling feel
motion_system.hero_reveal: Framer Motion kinetic mask reveal on page load
motion_system.card_hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 scale-[1.01] transition with border-white/40 highlight
motion_system.nfc_waves: Animated pulse keyframes simulating contactless NFC signal emission
motion_system.marquee: Slow technical ticker in mono font showcasing service capabilities

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, language toggles, tabs, and form submissions MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='language-toggle-tr', data-testid='hero-cta-discover', data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: Ensure white text over #050505 background achieves >90 Lc APCA readability score.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full outline focus rings on interactive elements with ring-white/50.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete dark minimal Awwwards-caliber landing application for Lachen & Co.
Strictly adhere to the brand logo format: LACHEN.CO. with 3 animated SVG radio wave arcs after the trailing dot.
Implement language state management (TR and EN) with persistent state or React state context.
Ensure all metric mockups have clear 'DEMO VERİ / DEMO DATA' badges and zero fake testimonials or artificial company metrics.
Use testids on all interactive components as specified in testing_and_accessibility.
